question: Who has taken over as the new CEO of the Railway Board on 1st Jan 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Suneet Sharma**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Suneet Sharma** has taken over as the new CEO of the Railway Board on 1st January 2021.
 
• He succeeded **V K Yadav** in this position.
 
• The Railway Board is the apex body of the Indian Railways, responsible for the overall management and administration of the railways.</li&g
